recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-12170; any future work should be scoped to newer repeats-related trackers rather than reapplying this 2016 clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-12170 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Questionnaire clarification asking whether repeats=true on a question means repeated QuestionnaireResponse items or multiple answers in one response item. The approved guidance said multiple answers can be provided for the question, while rendering software may either repeat the question text per answer or present multiple answers beneath one question.
initial_application: Historical commit 76675fcc91938801ee4e8de9ec10d2c6e1949bc8 explicitly listed 12170 among Questionnaire clarifications and added the approved repeats=true guidance to the old questionnaire spreadsheet source. Later source refactors carried that guidance into the current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Later Published FHIR-33335 refined the same repeats representation model by adding qrs-2 and making explicit that repeated question answers are represented as multiple answers in one item, while repeated groups use repeated items. Later Applied FHIR-55973, already represented on the combined branch, added the distinct-answer qualifier and qrs-4 without reversing the FHIR-12170 rule.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current Questionnaire.item.repeats definition and comment already state that a repeats=true question produces one QuestionnaireResponse question item with multiple distinct answers and that rendering may either repeat question text or allow multiple answer entry/selection.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue on the same repeats representation model; it refined the base Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse wording/invariant but did not supersede the FHIR-12170 clarification.
